title: ジャパンカップの後に・歪み

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pathetic. That's all there is to say.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I haven't the time to be discouraged with myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: For now… I must improve!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And so, I ask you, Trainer. Please…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Take me to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Arrange it so that I may face her at the illustrious Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's been my intention since I started on this path.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Determination. I cannot turn my back on that promise.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I will prove my worth as Maruzen's "Successor"—and then I will overtake her as the true Beast!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Only then will… Oh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, but I thought I heard…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …El?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, El…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …? I wonder what's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Normally, we'd be hearing her laughter from miles away about now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think back on how tenacious El Condor Pasa appeared during summer camp.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I have to be the one her eyes are following on the track—the one she glares at with such fire!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For Grass Wonder, everything is just a stepping stone on the path to Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From El Condor Pasa's point of view, that must be…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now you're acting strange too. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is an extremely important time for Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all the work she's been putting in, telling her now might throw her off pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, I keep my mouth shut.
